chunks: He was sent while the people were astray in perplexity,
and moving here and there in mischief. Desires had deflected them and self-conceit had swerved them. Extreme ignorance had made them foolish:
Confounded by the unsteadiness of matters and the evils of ignorance,
Then the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) did his best in giving them sincere advice, himself trod on the right path and called (them) towards wisdom and good counsel.
ai.seo_question: What was the spiritual and social condition of people when Prophet Muhammad was sent?
ai.summary: Sharif al-Radi portrays the pre-Islamic era as a state of profound spiritual disorientation where desires and arrogance obscured truth, necessitating the Prophet's deliberate and persistent outreach. This narrative underscores the Shia emphasis on the Prophet's role as a guide who combats 'Jahiliyyah' not just through authority, but through wisdom (Hikmah) and gentle admonition (Maw'izah).

en.sayed-ali-raza: Allāh sent the Prophet at a time when the people were going astray in perplexity
and were moving here and there in mischief. Desires had deflected them and self-conceit had swerved them. Extreme ignorance had made them foolish.
They were confounded by the unsteadiness of matters and the evils of ignorance.
Then the Prophet — blessing of Allāh be upon him and his descendants — did his best in giving them sincere advice, himself trod on the right path and called (them) towards wisdom and good counsel.
